# Broke But Functional

> Gen Z Survival Budget & Personal Finance Tracker

## Overview
Broke But Functional is a fast personal finance tracking web application designed for students and young adults navigating monthly cash flows, committed bills, and discretionary spending. All data is stored locally in the browser (via IndexedDB), and bank and UPI connectors are simulated for demonstration.

## Core Features
- Dashboard: Safe-to-spend calculation, daily burn rate, and survival days left.
- Calendar: 30-day Mon-Sun timeline showing high-spend events, income, and bills.
- Commitments: Categorized bill tracker with due dates and payment status.
- Simulator: Scenario sandbox to model unexpected expenses and adjustments.
- Events: Timeline of unplanned expenses and financial surprises.
- Summary: Category breakdown and spending distribution.
- Connect: Simulated bank and UPI sync integrations.
- Settings: High-contrast themes, local data backup/export via IndexedDB.
